items.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion
items.inspection: End of Evangelion still: Shinji kneeling over Asuka on the red LCL sea under a starry sky, two Evas crucified in the distance. Clean, no text/logos. TMDB original 1920x1080.

items.title: Parasyte: The Grey
items.inspection: Moody still: suited Grey-team man standing before a crowd in a lamplit hall, blood-red parasyte symbol on the wall behind. Clean, no text/logos. Note: dark/atmospheric shot, no lead character visible.

items.title: Predator

items.title: RoboCop
items.inspection: Clean still: RoboCop walking through shallow water at the steel mill, gun raised. No text/logos. 1118x603.

items.title: Rocky

items.title: Smallville
